nodes.author: SOMHEALTHAWARE
nodes.text: HMPV stands for Human Metapneumovirus, a respiratory virus that causes infections in the lungs and airways. It is similar to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and often affects young children, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems.

nodes.author: SOMHEALTHAWARE
nodes.text:
Symptoms of HMPV Infection:
Cough
Nasal congestion
Fever
Shortness of breath
Sore throat
Wheezing (in severe cases)
Transmission
Spread through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes
Close contact with an infected person or touching contaminated surfaces

nodes.author: SOMHEALTHAWARE
nodes.text:
Prevention:

Wash hands regularly.

Avoid close contact with sick individuals.

Clean frequently touched surfaces.
